column2: New year, same laptop. Didn't upgrade because honestly it still works fine. The urge to buy new gear in January is real though. Resisting. #RemoteWork
2026 goal: actually use the tools I'm paying for. Did an audit - paying for 12 subscriptions, actively using 5. Classic. #Productivity
First work day of the year. Inbox has 847 emails. Most are newsletters I forgot I subscribed to. Today's task: unsubscribe from everything. #WorkFromHome
Hot take: New Year productivity content is mostly recycled. Same advice, new date. The basics haven't changed - focus, rest, repeat. #Productivity
Tested five VPNs over the holidays. Three dropped connections constantly. One was painfully slow. One actually worked. Writing up the comparison now. #Cybersecurity
January resolution: no more working from bed. Lasted three days last year. Setting the bar low this time - maybe a full week. #RemoteWork
Coworking space raised prices again. Now paying more than my home internet for worse coffee and ambient typing sounds. Math isn't mathing. #DigitalNomad
Friend asked for laptop recommendations. Told him anything with 16GB RAM and decent battery. He bought the cheapest one anyway. Some things never change. #RemoteWork
Sunday work session. Just me, coffee, and zero Slack notifications. This is when the actual thinking happens. #Productivity
Cleaned my keyboard for the first time in months. Found a small ecosystem developing under the keycaps. Highly recommend not waiting this long. #HomeOffice
Client wants a call at 6am my time. Their 3pm. Time zones are just a constant source of mild suffering in remote work. #RemoteWork
Password manager saved me again today. Site I forgot existed got breached. Had a unique password there. Changed it in 10 seconds. Worth every penny. #Cybersecurity
The most productive thing I did today was saying no to three meetings. Protect your calendar like it's your job. Because it kind of is. #Productivity
Webcam quality tip: it's almost never the camera. It's the lighting. Face a window. Boom. Better than any $200 webcam. #RemoteWork
Invoice sent: $2,400. Invoice paid: 47 days later. Freelance life is just advanced patience training. #FreelanceLife
Tried the Pomodoro technique again. Worked for exactly two days before I forgot about the timer completely. Some methods just don't stick. #Productivity
Home office upgrade that actually mattered: a plant. Not for oxygen or whatever. Just nice to look at something alive during calls. #HomeOffice
VPN tip: the kill switch matters more than speed. Rather have slow internet than accidentally exposed traffic. #Cybersecurity
Friday afternoon and I'm done for the week. Remote work perk: nobody sees you close the laptop at 3pm. Weekend starts now. #WorkLifeBalance
Backed up my files today. Took 20 minutes. The peace of mind lasts all year. Do it. #Productivity
Weekend project: organizing my digital files. Three hours in and I'm just looking at old photos. Productivity is a myth. #RemoteWork
Best purchase of 2025 was noise canceling headphones. Not close. Changed everything about working from cafes. #DigitalNomad
Sunday planning session. Wrote down three things to accomplish this week. That's it. Three. More than that and nothing gets done. #Productivity
Remote work confession: sometimes I take meetings while walking outside. Nobody can tell. Fresh air helps me think. #RemoteWork
Monday morning and my internet is down. Working from phone hotspot like it's 2015. Always have a backup connection plan. #RemoteWork
Project management tools ranked by how often I actually open them: Apple Notes, then nothing else. The simple tools win. #Productivity
Got a phishing email that almost fooled me. Looked exactly like a real invoice. Always check the sender domain. Always. #Cybersecurity
Standing desk update: been sitting more lately. Winter makes standing feel worse somehow. The $400 desk is currently a regular desk. #HomeOffice
Halfway through January. Checked on my resolutions. They're doing fine without me apparently. #Productivity
Time tracking revelation: I spend 4 hours a day on actual work. The rest is meetings, admin, and staring at walls. Eye-opening. #Productivity
Client asked why I charge what I charge. Sent them my expense list. Suddenly the rate made sense. Know your numbers. #FreelanceLife
Two monitors vs one ultrawide. Tried both. Ultrawide wins for focus. Two monitors wins for multitasking. Pick based on how you work. #HomeOffice
Friday flex: finished all my work by noon. Spent the afternoon reading. This is why I went remote in the first place. #WorkLifeBalance
Email marketing tool comparison coming soon. Tested four of them. They all do the same thing with different UI. The price differences are wild though. #FreelanceLife
Saturday morning and I'm not working. Progress. The old me would have opened the laptop by now. Growth is boring but real. #WorkLifeBalance
Travel adapter tip: get the universal one. Carrying three different adapters is annoying. One good one covers everywhere. #DigitalNomad
Planning my first trip of 2026. Already anxious about working from airports. Portable charger is non-negotiable. #DigitalNomad
The best video call setup is the one where you can forget about the tech. Camera works, mic works, done. Simplicity wins. #RemoteWork
Monday motivation: there is none. Just start working anyway. Motivation follows action, not the other way around. #Productivity
VPN question I get asked most: do you really need one? Short answer: yes if you use public WiFi. Otherwise, still probably yes. #Cybersecurity
Expense tracking saved me $200 on taxes last year. Just from stuff I almost forgot to deduct. Worth the 10 minutes a month. #FreelanceLife
Home office confession: my cable management is a disaster. Works though. Nobody sees under my desk on video calls. #HomeOffice
Mechanical keyboard update: it's loud. My partner hates it. I love it. This is a relationship test disguised as a purchase. #HomeOffice
Two-factor authentication reminder: set it up on everything. Yes, it's annoying. Yes, it's worth it. Do it today. #Cybersecurity
Client communication tip: overcommunicate. Then communicate some more. Remote work means no hallway conversations. Fill the gap. #RemoteWork
Invoicing software changed my life. Used to send Word docs like an amateur. Now it's automated reminders and actual payments. #FreelanceLife
Friday and I closed three tabs. That's the whole productivity tip. Close the tabs. Focus on one thing. Revolutionary. #Productivity
Microphone upgrade was worth it. Went from laptop mic to dedicated USB mic. Clients actually comment on the audio quality now. #RemoteWork
Weekend plans: absolutely nothing work related. The laptop stays closed. This is a promise I'm making publicly for accountability. #WorkLifeBalance
Digital nomad visa research continues. Portugal and Spain both look good. Leaning toward Portugal for the cost of living. #DigitalNomad
Sunday evening planning. Looked at the week ahead. Four meetings. That's 3.5 too many. Going to decline some tomorrow. #Productivity
International payment tip: Wise beats PayPal on fees almost every time. Just saying. Do the math on your next transfer. #FreelanceLife
Started the week by turning off email notifications. Will check twice a day. The anxiety might kill me but the productivity won't. #Productivity
Web hosting comparison dropping soon. Tested for uptime, speed, and support. Spoiler: support is where most fail. #RemoteWork
Freelancer tax season approaching. Already dreading it. At least I tracked expenses better this year. Small wins. #FreelanceLife
WiFi at this cafe is 3 Mbps. That's technically internet. Barely. Hotspot it is. Always have backup internet. Always. #DigitalNomad
Notion vs alternatives debate continues. Tried switching. Came back. Some tools just work for your brain. Stop fighting it. #Productivity
Retirement planning as a freelancer is terrifying. No 401k match. No pension. Just you and compound interest. Start early. #FreelanceLife
Almost end of January. Time moves faster when you work from home. The days blur together. Calendar blocking helps. #RemoteWork
Slack vs Teams vs Discord debate: they all work. Pick the one your team already uses. Tool wars are a waste of time. #RemoteWork
Last day of January. Made it through the first month of 2026. Still working remote. Still happy about it. Onward to February. #RemoteWork
Monthly review: shipped three articles, landed two clients, took weekends off. Good month. Simple metrics, clear progress. #Productivity
